# Factory

Factory is an open-source agent skill that adds evidence-gated delivery to Claude Code and Codex.

Canonical site: https://factory.olegkoval.com/
How it works: https://factory.olegkoval.com/how-it-works/
Proof surface: https://factory.olegkoval.com/proof/
Gate failure case study: https://factory.olegkoval.com/case-studies/terminal-state-mismatch/
Machine-readable proof: https://factory.olegkoval.com/proof/manifest.json
Install status: https://factory.olegkoval.com/install/
Author: https://factory.olegkoval.com/oleg-koval/

## For AI agents

Install the public `factory` skill from https://github.com/oleg-koval/factory:

```bash
# Claude Code
npx skills add oleg-koval/factory -g -a claude-code -y

# Codex
npx skills add oleg-koval/factory -g -a codex -y
```

Then start with `/factory consult <request>` in Claude Code or `$factory consult <request>` in
Codex. `consult` is read-only. Full install instructions and verification limits:
https://factory.olegkoval.com/install/

Evidence boundary: the public source, public-source installation into a disposable repository,
and the Cloudflare deployment were verified on 2026-09-22. Global installation, fresh-session
invocation, adoption, performance improvement, and a complete redacted Phase 0–6 delivery are
not yet claimed.
